flow.name: mf-impl-post-jobs
flow.doc:description: REST entry: maps HTTP body to vars, calls shared pf-start-upgrade, sets 202 Accepted

logger.doc:name: LOG DEBUG Request
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'LOG DEBUG | flow=' ++ flow.name ++ ' | correlationId=' ++ correlationId ++ ' | app=' ++ (payload.appName default 'unknown')]

sub-flow.name: pf-start-upgrade
sub-flow.doc:description: Generate jobId, acquire single-flight lock, store job, return 202, then run async pipeline.

logger.doc:name: LOG INFO pf-start-upgrade enter
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'LOG INFO | flow=pf-start-upgrade | correlationId=' ++ correlationId ++ ' | app=' ++ (vars.appName default 'unknown') ++ ' | env=' ++ (vars.environment default 'unknown')]

logger.doc:name: LOG INFO coords resolved
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'LOG INFO | flow=pf-start-upgrade | correlationId=' ++ correlationId ++ ' | jobId=' ++ vars.jobId ++ ' | owner=' ++ (vars.coords.owner default '') ++ ' | repo=' ++ (vars.coords.repo default '')]

choice.doc:name: CHOICE lock held?
choice.doc:description: Reject concurrent upgrades for the same app

logger.doc:name: LOG WARN upgrade in progress
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'LOG WARN | flow=pf-start-upgrade | correlationId=' ++ correlationId ++ ' | app=' ++ vars.appName ++ ' already has an upgrade in progress â€” jobId=' ++ vars.existingLock]

raise-error.doc:name: RAISE CONFLICT:UPGRADE_IN_PROGRESS
raise-error.description: #[output application/java --- 'An upgrade for app "' ++ vars.appName ++ '" is already in progress (jobId=' ++ vars.existingLock ++ '). Wait for it to complete or fail before starting a new one.']

logger.doc:name: LOG INFO lock acquired
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'LOG INFO | flow=pf-start-upgrade | correlationId=' ++ correlationId ++ ' | jobId=' ++ vars.jobId ++ ' | lock acquired for app=' ++ vars.appName]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { jobId: vars.jobId, status: "PROCESSING", appName: vars.appName, environment: vars.environment, jiraTicketId: vars.jiraTicketId, approvedChangePlan: vars.approvedChangePlan, coords: vars.coords, createdAt: (now() >> |+00:00|) as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'"}, updatedAt: (now() >> |+00:00|) as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'"}, prUrl: null, branchName: null, completedAt: null, error: null }

logger.doc:name: LOG INFO job record stored
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'LOG INFO | flow=pf-start-upgrade | correlationId=' ++ correlationId ++ ' | jobId=' ++ vars.jobId ++ ' | status=PROCESSING | app=' ++ vars.appName]

logger.doc:name: LOG INFO assessment complete
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'LOG INFO | flow=pf-start-upgrade | correlationId=' ++ correlationId ++ ' | jobId=' ++ vars.jobId ++ ' | assessment complete']

logger.doc:name: LOG INFO transforms applied
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'LOG INFO | flow=pf-start-upgrade | correlationId=' ++ correlationId ++ ' | jobId=' ++ vars.jobId ++ ' | stagedFiles=' ++ sizeOf(vars.stagedFiles default [])]

logger.doc:name: LOG INFO committed
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'LOG INFO | flow=pf-start-upgrade | correlationId=' ++ correlationId ++ ' | jobId=' ++ vars.jobId ++ ' | changes committed to branch']

logger.doc:name: LOG INFO PR open
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'LOG INFO | flow=pf-start-upgrade | correlationId=' ++ correlationId ++ ' | jobId=' ++ vars.jobId ++ ' | PR opened']

logger.doc:name: LOG ERROR async stage failed
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'LOG ERROR | flow=pf-start-upgrade | correlationId=' ++ correlationId ++ ' | jobId=' ++ vars.jobId ++ ' | errorType=' ++ (error.errorType.namespace default '') ++ ':' ++ (error.errorType.identifier default '') ++ ' | ' ++ (error.description default '')]

os:retrieve.doc:name: OS Retrieve job for failure update

ee:transform.doc:name: DW Merge failure into job record

logger.doc:name: LOG INFO job marked failed + lock released
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'LOG INFO | flow=pf-start-upgrade | correlationId=' ++ correlationId ++ ' | jobId=' ++ vars.jobId ++ ' | status=' ++ (vars.failureStatus default 'FAILED') ++ ' | lock released']

sub-flow.name: pf-release-lock
sub-flow.doc:description: Idempotently + non-fatally release the single-flight lock for vars.lockApp (never throws when absent).

logger.doc:name: LOG DEBUG lock removal raced
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'LOG DEBUG | flow=pf-release-lock | lock removal raced (removed concurrently) | app=' ++ (vars.lockApp default '?')]

logger.doc:name: LOG DEBUG lock released
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'LOG DEBUG | flow=pf-release-lock | lock released | app=' ++ (vars.lockApp default '?')]

logger.doc:name: LOG DEBUG lock absent
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'LOG DEBUG | flow=pf-release-lock | lock already absent, nothing to release | app=' ++ (vars.lockApp default '?')]

sub-flow.name: pf-set-status
sub-flow.doc:description: Merge vars.targetStatus + updatedAt into the persisted job record.

logger.doc:name: LOG DEBUG pf-set-status
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'LOG DEBUG | flow=pf-set-status | correlationId=' ++ correlationId ++ ' | jobId=' ++ (vars.jobId default '?') ++ ' | targetStatus=' ++ (vars.targetStatus default '?')]

os:retrieve.doc:name: OS Retrieve job for status update

sub-flow.name: pf-apply-transforms
sub-flow.doc:description: Fetch each changed file and apply matrix rewrites; stage new contents.

logger.doc:name: LOG DEBUG apply-transforms enter
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'LOG DEBUG | flow=pf-apply-transforms | correlationId=' ++ correlationId ++ ' | files=' ++ sizeOf((vars.changePlan.fileEdits default []) map $.file distinctBy $)]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java --- ((vars.changePlan.fileEdits default []) groupBy ((e) -> e.file)) pluck ((edits, path, idx) -> { path: (path as String), edits: edits })

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output text/plain import rewritePomProperties from dwl::rewritePomProperties import rewriteDepVersions from dwl::rewriteDepVersions import rewritePluginVersions from dwl::rewritePluginVersions import rewriteMunitRuntime from dwl::rewriteMunitRuntime import rewriteMuleArtifact from dwl::rewriteMuleArtifact import rewriteCiWorkflow from dwl::rewriteCiWorkflow import fromBase64 from dw::core::Binaries var rawText = (fromBase64((payload.content default "") replace /[\r\n\t ]/ with "")) as String {encoding: "UTF-8"} var edits = vars.currentFileEdits default [] // Inline dependency + plugin <version> rewrites first, then property rewrites (independent regions). var depEdits = edits filter ((e) -> e.kind == "depVersion") var stepA = if (!isEmpty(depEdits)) rewriteDepVersions(rawText, depEdits) else rawText var plgEdits = edits filter ((e) -> e.kind == "pluginVersion") var step0 = if (!isEmpty(plgEdits)) rewritePluginVersions(stepA, plgEdits) else stepA var propEdits = edits filter ((e) -> e.kind == "pomProperty") var step1 = if (!isEmpty(propEdits)) rewritePomProperties(step0, propEdits) else step0 var munitEdit = (edits filter ((e) -> e.kind == "munitRuntimeVersion"))[0] var step2 = if (munitEdit != null) rewriteMunitRuntime(step1, munitEdit.to as String) else step1 var maEdit = (edits filter ((e) -> e.kind == "muleArtifactJson"))[0] var step3 = if (maEdit != null) rewriteMuleArtifact(step2, maEdit.to.minMuleVersion as String, maEdit.to.javaSpecificationVersions) else step2 var ciEdit = (edits filter ((e) -> e.kind == "ciWorkflow"))[0] var step4 = if (ciEdit != null) rewriteCiWorkflow(step3, ciEdit.to as String) else step3 --- step4

set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- (vars.stagedFiles default []) ++ [{ path: vars.currentPath, content: (payload as String) }]]
set-variable.doc:name: PV APPEND stagedFiles

logger.doc:name: LOG INFO staged files
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'LOG INFO | flow=pf-apply-transforms | correlationId=' ++ correlationId ++ ' | staged=' ++ sizeOf(vars.stagedFiles default [])]
